title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Profit and Loss
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: An article was bought for ₹8,900. Its price was marked up by 40%. Thereafter, it was sold at a discount of 5% on the marked price. What was the profit percentage on the transaction?
questions.explain: Let the Cost Price (CP) be $100\%$. Marked Price (MP) $= 100\% + 40\% = 140\%$. Selling Price (SP) $= MP - 5\%$ of MP $= 140\% - (0.05 \times 140\%) = 140\% - 7\% = 133\%$. The profit percentage $= SP - CP = 133\% - 100\% = 33\%$. The initial value ₹8,900 is not needed if only the percentage is asked.

questions.q: A fruit vendor bought 150 mangoes. He sold them at such a price that the selling price of 120 mangoes equals the cost price of 150 mangoes. Find his profit percentage.
questions.explain: Let the Cost Price (CP) of 1 mango be 1 unit. Then the CP of 150 mangoes is 150 units. The Selling Price (SP) of 120 mangoes equals the CP of 150 mangoes, so SP of 120 mangoes = 150. SP of 1 mango = $150 / 120 = 1.25$ units. Profit per mango = $1.25 - 1 = 0.25$ units. Profit Percentage = $(0.25 / 1) \times 100\% = 25\%$.
